title: fraud-evaluation-record
description: Fixed schema for committable fraud training and evaluation records. Every field is enforced by backend/app/scripts/evaluate_fraud_model.py and the unit tests in tests/unit/test_fraud_evaluation_schema.py. Same original conversation and its rewrites must share one split_group so no conversation leaks across train/eval sets.

text.description: One utterance transcript, with ASR noise applied when asr_noisy is true.

labels.description: Expected multi-label evidence kinds. Empty array marks a hard negative.

source.description: curated: hand written; augmented: paraphrased or ASR-noised rewrite; recorded: transcribed real audio with authorization and desensitization.

scenario.description: Scenario name, e.g. fake_customer_service, impersonating_police, delivery_refund, investment_pension, family_normal_transfer, anti_fraud_publicity.

split_group.description: Conversation group id. train.jsonl and eval_public.jsonl must not share any split_group value.

asr_noisy.description: True when this text is a noisy transcription (homophones, broken phrases) instead of clean writing.

expected_state.description: Optional expected session state after replaying the whole conversation this record belongs to (records sharing a split_group replay in file order).

expected_sequence.description: Optional expected conversation-level transcript sequence (record texts) used to order multi-turn splits.
